newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - OpCo cuts 3Com EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - OpCo cuts 3Com EPS view.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co analyst Randall Yuen said he cut his earnings 1997 year earnings estimate on 3Com Corp to $2.04 from $2.08 per share and lowered his 1998 year estimate to $2.33 from $2.44 per share.
-- The analyst said he kept his market perform rating on the stock.

-- He said the lower earnings estimates reflect lower revenue expectations for 3Com's systems business -- the hubs, switches and routers that make up 55 percent of its business. He also said he was concerned by rising operating expenses.
-- 3Com plans to merge with U.S. Robotics Corp.

-- The stock was up 1-3/4 to 35-3/8 in pre-open trading Friday following the release of results for the third quarter ended in February that were slightly ahead of expectations, which had been guided lower by the company in February.
